concept.hr: Dvije stanice koje se ne čuju sudaraju se na access pointu
concept.en: Two stations out of range of each other collide at the access point

summary.hr: A i C čuju B, ali ne jedna drugu: obje šalju i sudaraju se na B, a nijedna to ne primijeti. S RTS/CTS-om C čuje CTS od B i čeka.
summary.en: A and C hear B but not each other: both send and collide at B, and neither notices. With RTS/CTS, C hears the CTS from B and waits.
